key_insight: Large language models are expanding AI in medicine beyond narrow tasks by offering more flexible support for research and clinical workflows.
clinical_relevance: LLMs may help with medical information processing and decision-support related tasks, but their role in direct clinical use still needs careful validation and governance.
method: Narrative perspective on recent talks and articles
Focus on LLM applications in research and clinical practice
Examines both opportunities and implementation challenges
evidence_signal: The abstract is a perspective piece rather than an empirical study, so it summarizes emerging literature and discussion instead of reporting new dataset-based evaluation.
watch_item: Reliability, accuracy, transparency, and safety remain key concerns before LLMs can be broadly trusted in medical settings.
paper_title: Applying Language Models in Clinical Medicine: Recent Trends and Perspectives
